scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings && node tools/with-rustup.mjs cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && node --test tools/*.test.mjs && node tools/with-rustup.mjs cargo test --workspace
scripts.check: node tools/with-rustup.mjs cargo fmt --all --check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
